Join the Oakley Group

We are always interested in hearing from enthusiastic students and researchers interested in joining the group. Below are a list of current opportunities and potential funding avenues.

CURRENT OPPORTUNITIES

3.5-year PhD position — coming soon

Sept 2026: We will soon advertise a 3.5-year PhD position in the Oakley Group. Details will be posted here when the position opens.

Undergraduate research

Interested in an undergraduate research project? Please email me with a current CV and brief statement of interest before January. We can then discuss potential projects and funding.

Funding opportunities

  • Departmental & RSC undergraduate research bursaries: applications open in January. See the RSC undergraduate research bursaries.

  • Learning Through Research Student Experience Internships: opportunities through the University of Manchester.

  • Porter Prize: supports undergraduate research for students who are not yet in their final year. More information.

  • Mitacs Globalink Research Award: 12–24 week research internships for eligible Canadian students. More information.

Postgraduate research

Interested in a PhD in the Oakley Group? Please email me with a current CV and brief statement of interest. We can then discuss potential projects and funding.

Funding opportunities

  • President’s Doctoral Scholarship: University of Manchester.

  • Dean’s Doctoral Scholarship: University of Manchester.

  • School of Natural Sciences Diversity PhD Scholarships: for eligible UK Black-heritage students. More information.

  • Postgraduate Research Teaching Associate (PGRTA) Scholarships: PhD funding combining research and teaching. More information.

  • Mitacs Globalink Research Award: 12–24 week research internships for eligible Canadian students. More information.

See the University’s full list of postgraduate funding opportunities.

Postdoctoral researchers

Interested in joining the Oakley Group as a postdoc? There are currently no funded postdoctoral positions in the group, but I am happy to support suitable external fellowship applications. Please email me with a current CV and brief statement of interest.

External fellowships

  • Marie Skłodowska-Curie Actions Postdoctoral Fellowships
  • EPSRC Postdoctoral Fellowships
  • AXA Postdoctoral Fellowships
  • Newton International Fellowships: non-UK researchers
  • NSERC Postdoctoral Fellowships: Canadian candidates
  • Mitacs Globalink Research Award: Canadian candidates, 12–24 week internship
  • Banting Postdoctoral Fellowships: Canadian candidates
  • Branco Weiss Fellowships
  • Leopoldina Postdoc Scholarship: German, Austrian or Swiss candidates
  • SNSF Postdoc Mobility Fellowship: Swiss candidates
